components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one committed next step in a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.95rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 0); background: var(--color-cobalt, #3159ec); color: #fff; font: 550 15px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-cobalt-ink, #1d3bb8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-cobalt, #3159ec) 45%, white); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-cobalt-ink, #1d3bb8); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.95rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #d8dde4); border-radius: var(--radius, 0); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: #16191f; font: 550 15px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #eef1f6; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-cobalt, #3159ec) 45%, white); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary action; faint ink wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 0); background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 550 0.875rem/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(17, 20, 26, 0.06); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-cobalt, #3159ec) 45%, white); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Surface field with a Line stroke and cobalt-mix focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 550; color: #2b313b; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #d8dde4); border-radius: var(--radius, 0); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: #16191f; font: 400 15px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #c4cad3; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-cobalt, #3159ec) 45%, white); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat white well for queues, inspectors, and policy.
components.html:
Operations queue

12 requests in this workspace.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.85rem; padding: 1.1rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #d8dde4); border-radius: var(--radius, 0); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #16191f; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-desc { margin: 0; color: var(--color-quiet, #5d6673); font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Warning Badge
components.description: Pending, staged, and simulator — never a live-model cue.
components.css: .ds-badge-warning { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius, 0); font: 600 0.72rem/1.3 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; background: var(--color-amber-soft, #f6e7c6); color: #8a5b10; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Ink-rail destination; selected state is ink-soft, not cobalt.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 0.6rem; background: var(--color-ink, #11141a); border-radius: var(--radius, 0); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; width: 100%; min-height: 2.35rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius, 0); background: transparent; color: #c9d1de; font: 400 15px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-cobalt, #3159ec) 45%, white); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-nav-item-current, .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--color-ink-soft, #1b2029); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-count { margin-left: auto; min-width: 1.25rem; padding: 0 0.35rem; border-radius: var(--radius, 0); background: #2a3140; color: #f6e7c6; font-size: 0.7rem; text-align: center; }

components.name: Simulator Well
components.description: Persistent rail block that stages a defined action and refuses live-agent chrome.
components.html:
Simulator · not a live model

This agent picks a defined action and stages it. It does not call a language model or send a purchase.
components.css: .ds-simulator { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.7rem; padding: 0.9rem; border-radius: var(--radius, 0); background: #1a2030; color: #d5dceb; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-simulator p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #9aa6b8; } .ds-simulator .ds-badge-warning { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius, 0); font: 600 0.72rem/1.3 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; background: var(--color-amber-soft, #f6e7c6); color: #8a5b10; } .ds-simulator-btn { background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: #16191f; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #d8dde4); min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.95rem; border-radius: var(--radius, 0); font: 550 15px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-simulator-btn:hover { background: #eef1f6; } .ds-simulator-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-cobalt, #3159ec) 45%, white); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
Kernel is a desk, not a dashboard. Dark ink navigation sits to the side like furniture; cool paper is the working surface. The interface is precise, operational, and non-theatrical. Density is a feature: operators scan requests, diffs, and checks at 15px, with tabular numbers, and without decorative chrome.

Brand lives in the ink/paper split, in Newsreader titles that name the current job, and in the rarity of Signal Cobalt. Amber is not decoration — it marks review and the simulator, so a staged proposal never looks like a live agent. Confirmed rejections: theatrical agent glow, black “nova” primary buttons, sharp-corner admin kits, and Inter as the body face. Leftover shadcn tokens in the stylesheet are not the system.
keyCharacteristics: Ink chrome, paper work surface, white cards
Newsreader for titles; IBM Plex Sans for work
One cobalt fill per region; outline and ghost do the rest
Amber reserved for review, pending, and the simulator
Flat surfaces; shadows only on overlays
Dense enough for actual operations, including at 980px

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Cobalt fills at most one primary control in a given region. Secondary actions are outline or ghost. Navigation chrome stays ink.

rules.name: The Quiet Token Rule
rules.body: Muted copy uses quiet. Never use the shadcn --muted / --color-muted variables for text — they resolve to a near-white wash.

rules.name: The Simulator Amber Rule
rules.body: Anything that is staged, pending, or simulated wears amber. Do not use cobalt or success to imply a live model.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Newsreader names the surface. IBM Plex runs the surface. Do not set body, tables, buttons, or badges in Newsreader. Do not set page titles in Plex or Inter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flush at rest. Shadows are a response to overlay, not a way to make a card feel important.

dos: Do keep the ink rail and paper canvas as the spatial identity of every authenticated screen.
Do use Newsreader only for page, auth, and dialog titles; IBM Plex for everything an operator types or scans.
Do put Signal Cobalt on a single filled action per region, and Review Amber on pending / simulator / warning.
Do draw edges with 1px Line and --radius: 0; use overlay shadows only on select and dialog.
Do label the simulator as not a live model, in amber, whenever it is on screen.
donts: Don't use Inter, a radius scale, pills, or near-black shadcn --primary fills — those leftovers are not Kernel.
Don't set --radius above 0 on bordered surfaces.
Don't paint navigation, headers, or card chrome in cobalt.
Don't use success green, cobalt, or agent sparkle to imply a live model.
Don't add rest-state drop shadows to cards or tables.
Don't switch body copy to --muted / --color-muted; that token is a near-white collision.
Don't invent a dark theme; .dark shadcn variables are unused by this product.
